problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis. When the displacement of $P$ from the origin is $x\,m,$ the velocity is $v\,m/s,$ and the acceleration is ${x}^{2}\,{m/s}^{2}.$ If $P$ has velocity $2\,m/s$ when its displacement is $\sqrt[3]{7}\,m,$ find the values of $x$ for which $P$ is instantaneously at rest.

activity_context.topic_title: Determining Properties of Objects Described as Functions of Displacement
